questions.typeHeader: TYPE - II: FATHER & SON AGE RELATION
questions.questionText: A father's age is $3$ times his son's age. If the son is currently $11$ years old, what will be the father's age after $8$ years?
questions.solution: Father's present age $= 3 \times 11 = 33$ years. After 8 years $= 41$ years.

questions.typeHeader: TYPE - III: SUM AND DIFFERENCE OF AGES
questions.questionText: The sum of the ages of two brothers is $54$ years and their age difference is $8$ years. Find the elder brother's age.
questions.solution: Elder brother $= \frac{\text{Sum} + \text{Diff}}{2} = \frac{54 + 8}{2} = 31\text{ years}$.

questions.typeHeader: TYPE - IV: RETROSPECTIVE AGE RATIOS
questions.questionText: $4$ years ago, a man was $3$ times as old as his son. If the son's age $4$ years ago was $15$ years, find the father's present age.
questions.solution: Father's age 4 years ago $= 3 \times 15 = 45$. Present age $= 45 + 4 = 49\text{ years}$.

questions.typeHeader: TYPE - I: AGE RATIO AFTER T YEARS
questions.questionText: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio $3 : 4$. If A is $27$ years old, find B's age after $5$ years.
questions.solution: B's present age $= \frac{4}{3} \times 27 = 36$ years. After 5 years $= 41$ years.
